1.5.0.changelog:
✨ Features:
 ᛫ 🍎 macOS is now supported!
 ᛫ 👤 Improved setting's "Connection" page and login page;
 ᛫ 🧪 Added beta update track;
 ᛫ 📁 Json and ips files are now handled in attachements with a proper Json viewer.
 ᛫ 🕜 Work item history view:
     ᛫ Work item history now shows an entry for the ticket's creation.
     ᛫ Improved display of some default field edits in history view
 ᛫ 😀 Assignee/reporter:
     ᛫ now show a higher-res profile picture;
     ᛫ their names can be copied.

🪲 Bug fixes
 ᛫ Settings dialog can now scroll when too small;
 ᛫ App now can no longer be shrunk below 900x600.
 ᛫ Link cards that aren't linking to Jira can now be opened in browser.

🧼 Chores
 ᛫ Bumped version number.
 ᛫ Added window_manager as dependency;
 ᛫ More code renamed to fit Jira's convention "work item" (instead of "issue" or "ticket");
 ᛫ Removed that ugly placeholder in Updates page.
 ᛫ In Settings > Advanced > Log-reading dialog
     ᛫ Added log level filter and search
     ᛫ Now legible in light mode

1.4.0.changelog:
✨ Features:
 ᛫ 🔍 Issue search is now available!
 ᛫ 💬 When the window is too small, the issue details section gets shown in a new modal
 ᛫ 🔗 Jira link tiles now open in an in-app dialog

🪲 Bug fixes
 ᛫ Updates section would reload in a never-ending loop if no project was selected
 ᛫ Windows: media_kit's video player is now statically kept to avoid crashes caused by underlying plugin after dispose calls
 ᛫ "To do" section fixes:
     ᛫ Filters menu now show filtered-out categories as options
     ᛫ Category is now saved when using "Add to tasks" button
     ᛫ Reworked the dang whole todotasks event system to fix UI jank and missed updates
 ᛫ Text renderer fixes:
     ᛫ Link cards were unreadable in light mode
     ᛫ Description panels would overflow if text was longer than could fit on one line

🧼 Chores
 ᛫ Bumped version number.
 ᛫ Updated  Dart SDK version, and made adequate fixes.

🐛 Known bugs
 ᛫ Emojis are not rendered in comments (there is no Atlassian API for that)   
 ᛫ Newer request is dropped by UI if project filters are changed before request completes
 ᛫ Comments: nested replies are not shown as nested

1.3.0.changelog:
✨ Features:
 ᛫ 📝 New TO DO system allows to easily set issues aside for later :D
 ᛫ 🅰️ Text renderer improvements:
     ᛫ Tables, panels, images and videos are now rendered
     ᛫ Whole description and comments can now be selected and copied
 ᛫ 🧭 Main navigation pages now persist through navigation rail selections
 ᛫ ☀️ Assigned to and Reporter field are now lit when you are the person in it

🪲 Bug fixes
 ᛫ 😎 SVGs from jira would not get in-line style (eg. colors would be lost)
 ᛫ 🅰️ Text renderer fixes:
     ᛫ 🔗 Links from the details view would not open in browser
     ᛫ 🥸 Mentions were unreadable in light mode
     ᛫ 🧑‍🚀 Corrected spacing after AdfRenderer widgets
 ᛫ 🛞 Attachements loading animation was stretched horizontally
 ᛫ 🙍 Incorrect person was shown as updater when the update was a comment
 ᛫ 🛑 App no longer commits seppuku when switching pages then editing projects (setstate after dispose)

🧼 Chores
 ᛫ Bumped version number.
 ᛫ Added dependency to xml.

🐛 Known bugs
 ᛫ Emojis are not rendered in comments (there is no Atlassian API for that)
 ᛫ Newer request is dropped by UI if project filters are changed before request completes
 ᛫ Comments: nested replies are not shown as nested
